text: Cross-node pod connections timed out after a routine maintenance window. Historical context: Datadog reports that a systemd-networkd restart removed pod routing rules during unattended updates across environments. Useful checks: Compare host routing and maintenance history with cloud firewall decisions for the failed packet path.
note: Original synopsis and diagnostic suggestions; historical analogy is not proof of a current cause.

text: A node-agent rollout coincided with API timeouts and slow scheduling. Historical context: Reddit reports that cached-image startup synchronized large LIST requests and exhausted control-plane VM memory. Useful checks: Compare audit request concurrency and API memory with etcd fsync latency and the rollout start-time distribution.
note: Original synopsis and diagnostic suggestions; historical analogy is not proof of a current cause.

text: Services vanished from the cluster shortly after an infrastructure change. Historical context: Skyscanner reports a templating change producing an empty desired state and automated reconciliation deleting resources. Useful checks: Inspect rendered desired state and the identity, timestamps and targets of resource deletion audit events.
note: Original synopsis and diagnostic suggestions; historical analogy is not proof of a current cause.

text: A rolling update stalled while new pods repeatedly ran out of memory. Historical context: Grafana reports a Service selector excluding old replicas, concentrating traffic on a small updated subset and causing OOMs. Useful checks: Compare Service selectors and EndpointSlices with per-pod traffic and equal-workload memory profiles.
note: Original synopsis and diagnostic suggestions; historical analogy is not proof of a current cause.

text: Cloud API access stopped and replacement nodes failed after a quiet interval. Historical context: Stytch reports a deleted shared instance profile, failed replacement provisioning and delayed failures on existing nodes. Exact credential expiry and role-removal API calls are fixture details, not verified historical observations. Useful checks: Inspect instance-profile references and audit history, credential expiry and trusted clock offset without exposing credentials.
note: Original synopsis and diagnostic suggestions; historical analogy is not proof of a current cause.

text: A running Redis pod became unreachable through its internal load balancer. Historical context: GitLab reports that a PDB prevented Redis pod eviction while a GKE controller independently removed its load-balancer endpoint. Useful checks: Compare direct pod reachability, endpoint-group membership, target health and network-policy drop evidence.
note: Original synopsis and diagnostic suggestions; historical analogy is not proof of a current cause.

text: Newly deployed pods fail TLS calls while old pods continue serving. Historical context: Shopify reports an expired root and stale client trust bundle; existing TLS connections concealed the problem until pod replacement forced new handshakes. Useful checks: Compare fresh versus reused connections, certificate SAN/validity, request hostname and the actual client trust store.
note: Original synopsis and diagnostic suggestions; historical analogy is not proof of a current cause.

text: A stateful tool takes a long time to start after replacement. Historical context: Cloudflare reports long pod startup delays while kubelet recursively changed volume group ownership across many files. Useful checks: Establish whether delay occurs during attach, mount, ownership processing or application initialization.
note: Original synopsis and diagnostic suggestions; historical analogy is not proof of a current cause.

The precise kernel locking explanation remains qualified; direct lock traces and a controlled re-enable experiment in our exercise are fictional evidence. text: Some pods have intermittent DNS timeouts after CoreDNS scaled down. Historical context: Preply reports DNS failures after CoreDNS scale-down with traffic directed to a removed endpoint. The underlying conntrack cleanup failure was not conclusively established. Useful checks: Inspect failing flow destinations and policy decisions; do not claim the underlying conntrack cleanup defect without more evidence.
note: Original synopsis and diagnostic suggestions; historical analogy is not proof of a current cause.

text: A simulation finished its workload but never completed cleanup. Historical context: ACRL reports a fail-open webhook certificate race followed by mutation errors: ordinary Pod updates failed on nodeSelector changes and kubelet status updates failed on label changes. Useful checks: Inspect admission timing and rules, accepted status updates, deletionTimestamp, finalizers and their owning controller.
note: Original synopsis and diagnostic suggestions; historical analogy is not proof of a current cause.

text: Autoscaling launched instances but application pods remain Pending. Historical context: FREE NOW reports that a moved package invalidated a hardcoded bootstrap URL, leaving launched worker instances unable to join Kubernetes. Useful checks: Compare cloud instance counts with node registration, then inspect bootstrap completion and API authentication errors.
